introduction: South Dakota Medicaid and CHIP applications use the state Economic Assistance intake routes. Different household members may qualify under different coverage categories.
description: South Dakota Medicaid and CHIP applications use the state Economic Assistance intake routes. Different household members may qualify under different coverage categories.

sections.who: DSS assesses children, pregnancy, adult expansion and age or disability categories using their financial and other rules.
sections.get: Approved coverage helps with eligible medical services. Coverage and care arrangements depend on the category.

sections.apply:
1. Start with DSS medical intake

    Use the online, paper or assistance routes.

  2. Complete the household review

    Supply records requested for each person seeking coverage.

  3. Read the approval

    Review member instructions and provider arrangements.
sections.after: Keep contact details current and follow renewal notices. Expansion enrollees should read the state’s January 2027 community-engagement guidance and exemptions.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Medical intake, Coverage categories, 2027 expansion changes. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can an adult without children qualify?
DSS lists an expansion category for qualifying adults ages 19–64.
Are community-engagement requirements already effective October 2026?
Does that rule affect every Medicaid recipient?
The state guidance identifies expansion adults, with exclusions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
